Generate comprehensive documentation for this code:

```python
import re
from collections import Counter

def extract_keywords(text, top_n=10, min_length=3):
    stop_words = {"the", "a", "an", "is", "are", "was", "were", "be",
                  "been", "being", "have", "has", "had", "do", "does",
                  "did", "will", "would", "could", "should", "may",
                  "might", "shall", "can", "need", "dare", "ought",
                  "used", "to", "of", "in", "for", "on", "with", "at",
                  "by", "from", "as", "into", "through", "during",
                  "before", "after", "above", "below", "between",
                  "and", "but", "or", "nor", "not", "so", "yet",
                  "both", "either", "neither", "each", "every",
                  "this", "that", "these", "those", "it", "its"}
    words = re.findall(r"\b[a-z]+\b", text.lower())
    filtered = [w for w in words if w not in stop_words and len(w) >= min_length]
    return Counter(filtered).most_common(top_n)
```
